Open-label RCT comparing NPL insulin vs insulin glargine added to metformin + sulfonylurea. Outcomes include HbA1c, fasting glucose, hypoglycemic events, insulin dose, body weight. Does NOT assess lactic acidosis or blood lactate levels.

Randomized multicentre study comparing extended-release metformin vs immediate-release metformin. Outcomes include HbA1c, BMI, post-prandial glycaemia, lipid profiles, insulin resistance (HOMA-IR), islet function (HOMA-B). Does NOT assess lactic acidosis or blood lactate levels.

Multicenter double-blind placebo-controlled RCT evaluating glipizide GITS vs placebo added to metformin. Outcomes include A1c, fasting plasma glucose, insulin concentrations, lipid profile, BMI, general safety variables. Does NOT specifically assess lactic acidosis or blood lactate levels.

Post hoc analyses of 3 published RCTs comparing insulin lispro mixtures vs insulin glargine in metformin-treated patients. Outcomes are exclusively glycemic variability indices (standard deviation, coefficient of variation, M-value, mean amplitude of glycemic excursion, J-index). Does NOT assess lactic acidosis or blood lactate levels.
